No group-specific effects. Final=.95p_V25+.05p_newGAM; p_V25=.75p_correctedKumo+.25p_originalSpline. Fixed5% new contribution, no outer weight/route selection; mean5foldtest.

definition.label: Posterior uncertainty integration of fixed correction
definition.formula: Independent normal working distributions for price_log and bureau latent means with their existing posteriorSD. Evaluate frozen V25 correction at mu+sqrt(2)*SD*t over3x3 Gauss-Hermite nodes, normalized product weights; no refit. p_corrected=.95*p_V25_corrected+.05*E[p_corrected(draw)]; final=.75*p_corrected+.25*originalSpline77. Missing mean stays missing, missingSD gives point estimate; nonnegativeSD asserted.
definition.rationale: V25 uses posterior means plus SD as separate inputs but evaluates nonlinear effects at a point. Test marginalization of uncertain measurements, especially thin histories. Different from V202/V203 Laplace coefficient uncertainty and peer tensor mean-times-SD interactions. Independent Gaussian posteriors are a working approximation, not verified joint distributions; old global-reference provenance is inherited.

definition.head_gap_caveat: Correction-head gap is descriptive; for monotone standalone expert the original gap is unchanged and separate expert training/heldout metrics are provided.
definition.label: Leave-one-source-out correction consensus
definition.formula: Fit four original ridge.003 strength.5 heads on identical6k, each omitting exactly one of pricing(2), bureau(2), capacity(5), repayment(2) latent-feature blocks. Retain six coverage columns and employment. q=equal mean of four predictions; p_corrected=.95*p_V25_corrected+.05*q; final=.75*p_corrected+.25*originalSpline77. Context/backbone unchanged.
definition.rationale: Added histories/complexity repeatedly lowered AUC; test sensitivity to reliance on individual noisy views without changing Kumo context. V187/V219 resampled rows, whereas this ensemble changes correction information blocks. Not an ablation of the whole source because Kumo already contains those sources. Every member uses same6k and remains correlated.

definition.label: Function-variance regularized correction
definition.formula: Original V25 design X. For each input block j including its missing indicator, Cj=Xj-columnmean_train(Xj). Fit meanBCE(z+X*beta)+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2+.01/(2n)*sum_j||Cj*beta_j||^2 on6k. Offset-slope gets original ridge only; intercept unpenalized. Predict q=sigmoid(z+.5X*beta); p_corrected=.95*p_V25_corrected+.05*q; final75:25originalSpline.
definition.rationale: Noise audit identified duplicated coverage indicators and parameterization-dependent ridge. This adds a penalty on each learned feature effect variance, rather than coefficient differences(V200), low-rank compression(V240), or row leverage(V241). Existing ridge remains, so this is not claimed fully basis-invariant. Test reducing unstable amplitude without deleting risk information.

definition.head_gap_caveat: Correction-head gap is descriptive; for monotone standalone expert the original gap is unchanged and separate expert training/heldout metrics are provided.
definition.label: Small monotone credit-capacity expert
definition.formula: On56k outer-training rows fit a logistic additive model on four signedlog inputs: negativebureau, late30 propensity, installment/observed income, existing totalburden. Training quantiles[0,.25,.5,.75,1] define clipped unit ramps; nonnegative ramp coefficients, free intercept/missing flags, meanBCE+.01/2||nonintercept||^2. No categorical input. Final=.95*p_V25+.05*p_expert; fixed folds and no outer early stopping.
definition.rationale: V254-256 test unrestricted small spline experts; this distinct domain-constrained expert tests whether limiting reversal of credit/capacity effects improves robustness. Monotonic directions are financial hypotheses, not established causal laws, and may fail due to selection/confounding. Only four already available inputs, no raw-data or exposure changes.

definition.label: Shrunk nonlinear inner-OOF calibration
definition.formula: Original6k correction rows:3fold stratified inner splits seed52027+outerfold, fit same head on4000 and predict heldout2000. Fit nondecreasing isotonic q on6000 innerOOF probabilities/labels, clipping outside observed support and output[1e-5,1-1e-5]. Apply q to outer/test full6k-head score. p_corrected=.95*p_V25_corrected+.05*q(p_V25_corrected); final75:25originalSpline77.
definition.rationale: V186 tested affine and V189 group calibration. This tests nonlinear common score calibration without group prevalence shifts like ALL66. Positive95% anchor preserves strict corrected-Kumo ordering; standalone KS cannot improve from this transform, but fixed fusion with spline can change ranking. Inner4k/full6k distribution mismatch and isotonic overfit remain; assess only outer results.
